title: Explicit fixed-scalar coordinates for finite ring-sheaf refinement
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, and n a natural number. Let A=O_E/(varpi_E^(n+1)) and R the finite coefficient datum of [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. For an open immersion j, finiteFixedOpenIso is realization whiskered with the exact derivation of finiteOpenIso, followed by fixedDerivedOpenModel. For any scheme map g, finiteFixedPushIso is realization whiskered with the right derivation of finiteDirectImage_eq, followed by sfIntrinsicDerivedDirectImageComparison. For a witnessed intrinsic origin O on X, finiteFixedOpenAt first applies open extension to the inverse realization counit O.K → e_X(e_X.inverse(O.K)), then finiteFixedOpenIso. For a refinement r:c→d, finiteFixedRefinementOpenIso is finiteFixedOpenAt at d, realization of fixedRefinementOpen, inverse finiteFixedPushIso at r.hom, and direct image under r.hom of inverse finiteFixedOpenAt at c. All four are specified composites of actual isomorphisms; no arbitrary witness of an existence statement is selected. The auxiliary finiteScalarDirectImage is the actual sectionwise SheafOfModules.pushforward for a specified scalar map, not a chosen existence witness.

def finiteFixedRefinementOpenIso {X Y : Scheme.{w}} {f : X ⟶ Y}
    {c d : Compactification f} (r : c.Refinement d)
    (O : FrobeniusExchange.CompactOrigin (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) X) :
    let R := PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)
    (PurCompactSupport.openExtension R d.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj O.K ≅
      (PurCompactSupport.push R r.hom).obj
        ((PurCompactSupport.openExtension R c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj O.K)
